scope: Correct the normal GTK2 vertical down-stepper top band and lower-left clipped corner from role-derived trough pixels, and register both vertical cells against the retained SR10.4 VUE capture

reference.registration_note: The R325 candidate down crop is the lower 15x15 stepper in the full 40x280 image. Comparing that crop directly with the GTK2 lower cell at y=526 gives an exact match after the generated edge correction; the earlier 11-pixel first-row difference was in the GTK2 art, not crop registration.

implementation.vertical_active_trough: Independent 24x24 asset with a 2/2/4/4 border. The three upper-right pixels remain copied from the normal up-stepper. The clipped lower-left pixel at trough (1,21) is copied from down-stepper (1,14).
implementation.down_stepper_normal: Pixels x=2..12 on row 0 use the center face from the KDE-rendered ACTIVE trough. This removes GTK2's extra inner bevel and exposes the same trough band seen at the top of the VUE down-arrow cell.
implementation.color_policy: Every copied pixel comes from palette-rendered GTK2 assets; no product RGB constant was added.

generated_preview.gtk: GTK2 2.24.33, actual repository generator output loaded with Gtk.rc_parse in private Xvfb

comparison.changed_pixels: eleven interior pixels on the first row of the lower cell and the lower-left clipped relief pixel; no other vertical pixels changed

validation.palette_refresh: The test changes KDE roles and verifies both the down-stepper trough band and vertical relief sample follow the refreshed palette.

limits: This proof covers normal up/down vertical and left/right horizontal cells in the current palette only.
Held, hover, disabled states, full live application comparison and human visual review remain open.
The user's theme profile and applications were not changed or restarted; no input was sent to any VM.
